name: Dataminr Expands Partnership With NATO
snippet:
Dataminr Expands Partnership With NATO to Provide AI-powered Real-time Alerts for Global Force and Infrastructure Protection
“The indications and warnings created by Dataminr’s AI platform are the gold standard for fast and accurate real-time information on breaking events.” “We are thrilled to expand our partnership with NATO and to support their critical global mission,” said Ted Bailey, Founder and CEO of Dataminr.

name: Dataminr and NATO Deepen Partnership to Advance
snippet:
Feb 14, 2025 — The North Atlantic Treaty Organization ( NATO ) is deploying Dataminr to better protect networks and increase real - time cyber domain awareness using AI. Read more
This deployment expands on NATO’s existing three-year agreement for Dataminr First Alert, the company’s product for the public sector. Faced with daily hybrid and cyber attacks, NATO and its networks require constant vigilance to ensure strong cyber resilience.
